CardMaker recreation of the 0 side (The First Order Reigns) of [[The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed]] (PC-E1, March 2026), marked “E1”.

Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The Virtual Set 25 release sheet (August 2025) shows the original text and today's PC card image shows PC-E2 (May 2026); no copy of the card image between March and May 2026 was archived.

Text source: the Players Committee's card data of 14 March 2026 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/12dc0198 swccg-card-json 12dc0198], “Tweak Set 2026 - Dark”), kept by the PC as pre-errata card 20078 in [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/main/DarkPreErrata.json DarkPreErrata.json]. Text: “Deploy Crait and D'Qar systems, a Crait (or Supremacy) battleground site, and Tracked Fleet. For remainder of game, you may not deploy cards with ability except [Episode VII] cards. Supremacy is deploy = 7 to [Episode VII] systems. Once per turn, may ▼ a card with 'Supremacy' in title or an [Episode VII] battleground. While this side up, neither player loses more than 1 Force to Force drains at systems (unless Tracked Fleet there). Flip this card if Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated.'”

Made: 12 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (swccg.com/cardmaker), from the PC card image of the current printing (frame, art, art credit, title, destiny, margin name). CardMaker draws the [Episode VII] icon in its own style and places the corner icon at the right. The PC's wording of 'Supremacy' quotes on this version is not known; the data's single quotes are used. Not an official image.
